page.content:
Card-game company that bought New Japan and expanded NJPW World.

How Bushiroad connects

  • Topic: NJPW — Bushiroad bought New Japan and funded the Wrestle Kingdom boom.
  • Work: NJPW World — Bushiroad launched NJPW World to stream New Japan globally.

What is Bushiroad?

Bushiroad acquired New Japan in 2012, funding the Wrestle Kingdom stadium era, NJPW World streaming, and the international tours that carried Okada, Naito, and Ospreay abroad.

Key threads lead to NJPW and NJPW World.
